title: Introducing Healthcare Data in Juicebox
summary: Source healthcare professionals by license, specialty, and credentials. Search millions of profiles in plain English and verify NPI numbers before outreach.
body_markdown:
Today, we’re excited to introduce **Healthcare Data** in Juicebox, now available in beta.


Healthcare talent can be incredibly hard to find. Juicebox now helps you discover millions of healthcare professionals by license, specialty, credentials, and more.


Here's what beta users can access:


## **🔍 Search for Healthcare Professionals**


*Type in plain English to search across millions of healthcare profiles*


Most sourcing tools weren't built for healthcare recruiting.


Talent pools are scarce and candidate credentials are scattered across state registries and board databases.


Starting today in Juicebox, you can:


- **Search in plain English:** Just type in the healthcare professionals you're looking for in plain English and Juicebox builds the search for you based on your context
- **Refine with healthcare filters:** Filter by roles, licensing, specialty & training, clinical credentials, institution affiliations, and more
- **Unlock contact information:** Get emails and phone numbers for healthcare professionals directly in Juicebox


Juicebox combines healthcare data into one place, so you can go from a complex healthcare search to a qualified set of candidates in seconds.


## **🌐 Access Sources Across the Web**


*Search across Doximity, hospital websites, directories, and more*


Healthcare professionals don’t all maintain the same kind of online presence as candidates in other industries.


Their experience might live on Doximity, a hospital website, a private practice page, or another healthcare directory.


Juicebox brings those sources together, like:


- **Doximity profiles:** Access a candidate's Doximity profile directly in Juicebox
- **Professional pages across the web:** Surface hospital pages, practice websites, directories, and other relevant sources


You can now discover a much larger healthcare talent pool through the same searches and workflows you already use in Juicebox.


## **👤 View Healthcare Experience in Profiles**


*Credentials, specialties, licenses, work history, and education in one view*


Healthcare hiring comes with strict credentialing requirements: licensing in the right state, current board certifications, the right training.


Now all of it lives in one place.


Every healthcare professional now includes a Healthcare tab on their profile, including:


- **Credentials:** Board certifications and clinical certifications, with current status
- **Licenses:** Active licenses by state, licensing authority, number, and expiration dates
- **Specialties & training:** Their clinical field, subspecialties, and where they trained
- **Work history & education:** Their full experience, affiliations, and schooling


Verify a candidate has the right profile, including their NPI number, before you reach out so outreach only goes to healthcare professionals who match what you're looking for.


## **That's a wrap!**


Healthcare data is available to select beta users in[Juicebox.](https://app.juicebox.ai/)


If you're interested in becoming a beta users, please[book a demo with our team here.](https://xmy7g1zp2xj.typeform.com/to/xtLFIS5T)
